title: Alien Invasion or Sleep Paralysis?
summary: Editorial design exploring the liminal space between dreams and waking life through distorted typography, monochromatic imagery, and unsettling visual composition.
meta: Editorial spreads, display typography, black-and-white imagery

hero.alt: Looping preview of the editorial spread.

items.label: Project
items.text: Alien Invasion or Sleep Paralysis? explores the uneasy boundary between waking life and dreams. The editorial spreads translate the uncertainty of a liminal experience into a visual system that contrasts distorted typography, monochromatic imagery, and structured text.

items.label: Creative direction
items.text: The visual language balances psychological tension with editorial clarity. Distorted display typography introduces instability, while more structured text establishes a readable framework. Black-and-white imagery reinforces the ambiguous atmosphere, and an obscured alien-like shadow becomes a focal point that leaves the viewer questioning what is real.

items.label: Design approach
items.text: The layouts use contrast, hierarchy, image placement, and typographic distortion to communicate uncertainty without sacrificing readability. The tension between ordered information and unsettling imagery reflects the experience of being caught between a dream and reality.

blocks.label: 01 — Research
blocks.body: I chose "Alien Invasion or Sleep Paralysis?" because the topic fascinated me and offered a chance to explore the visual confusion between two surreal experiences.
